kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نرتعد (form VIII)
# نَرْتَعِدُ (nartaʕidu) /nar.ta.ʕi.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَعَدَ (irtaʕada)
# نَرْتَعِدَ (nartaʕida) /nar.ta.ʕi.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَعَدَ (irtaʕada)
# نَرْتَعِدْ (nartaʕid) /nar.ta.ʕid/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَعَدَ (irtaʕada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
